images.after: Minutes 0–5: search Google for your own site
images.title: What to spot in a site: search
images.alt: Checklist of things to look for in a site: search, from tag pages and staging copies to foreign-language spam and duplicate or truncated titles.
images.caption: Note each kind of problem once. The Page indexing report gives you the real numbers next.

items: Tag and archive pages, or internal search results
Test posts or a staging copy of the site
URLs with tracking parameters on the end
Pages in a language you never wrote (a sign of hacking)
Truncated titles, or one title on several pages
Results that show only your site name

images.title: Three checks in the Performance report
images.alt: Three Performance report checks: compare periods to find pages losing clicks, find near-miss queries, and spot two URLs competing for one search.
images.caption: Near misses already have Google's attention, so improving them usually pays back faster than new posts.

items.title: Find what's slipping
items.text: Compare with the previous period, then sort Pages by clicks difference.

items.title: Find near misses
items.text: Sort Queries by impressions. Note up to three just off the first page.

items.title: Spot competing pages
items.text: Open a key query's Pages tab. Two of your URLs there may be competing.

images.after: Minutes 50–60: turn the findings into a fix list
images.title: Sorting every finding
images.alt: Decision for each audit finding: if it stops a page being indexed, found or used, fix it this week; if it only helps, schedule it; otherwise ignore it.
images.caption: Keep the fix-this-week list to five items. Anything beyond that goes under Schedule.

data.question: Does this stop a page I care about from being indexed, found or used?

branches.result: Fix this week: noindex on a key page, failing sitemap, hacked pages.
Schedule: near-miss pages, posts to merge, internal links, speed items.
Ignore, and write down that you chose to.
